**1B.9 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** I found **no direct 2024 evidence** that Khamenei handled cyber, biological, AI, or other catastrophic-risk domains with a visible precautionary or transparent governance model. The closest evidence is nuclear: some late-year openness to IAEA access and continued talks, but also strong evidence of inspector restrictions and hardline/security dominance. Overall, the record is **mostly negative or thinly positive by proxy**, not affirmative.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-12-14 | [link](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Iran’s atomic chief said the country would not obstruct UN nuclear-watchdog inspections and would operate within safeguards. This is the strongest late-2024 sign of transparency in a catastrophic-risk domain, though it is still only a nuclear proxy, not evidence on cyber/biological/AI governance. | `1B.9`, `1B.3`, `1B.4`, `1B.7` |
| `Iran and IAEA will continue talks aimed at ending impasse, Grossi says` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-07 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaeas-grossi-seeks-deal-with-iran-on-nuclear-steps-soon-3425312) | After a visit to Iran, IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said talks would continue and a package of measures should be reached soon. This suggests at least some institutional channel remained open, but it is indirect evidence and does not show a broad precautionary culture. | `1B.9`, `1B.4`, `1B.8`, `1B.7` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors, and Reuters said Iran had removed many experienced inspectors. This is strong evidence against precaution and transparency in nuclear-risk management. | `1B.9`, `1B.3`, `1B.4`, `1B.7` |
| `Iranian commander warns Tehran could review 'nuclear doctrine' amid Israeli threats` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-04-18 | [link](https://theprint.in/world/iranian-commander-warns-tehran-could-review-its-nuclear-doctrine/2046641/) | Ahmad Haghtalab, the commander in charge of nuclear security, said Israeli threats could push Tehran to review and deviate from its nuclear doctrine. That places a sensitive risk domain in the hands of a security commander and signals brinkmanship rather than transparent, expert-led caution. | `1B.9`, `1B.2`, `1B.3`, `1B.5`, `1B.7` |
| `Iran’s presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists` | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-25 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879) | Reuters said Khamenei ensured candidates sharing his hard-line views dominated the presidential contest and that the Guardian Council was aligned with him. This is not dual-use policy directly, but it supports the reading that the wider decision environment favored loyalists over independent risk-reducing expertise. | `1B.9`, `1B.7`, `1B.6` |

**Assessment**

- **Best positive evidence:** limited, nuclear-only, and procedural. Iran said it would not impede IAEA access and kept talks going.
- **Best negative evidence:** inspector restrictions, removal of experienced inspectors, and security-hardliner dominance.
- **Net reading for 2024:** I do **not** find a demonstrated pattern of precaution and transparency across catastrophic-risk domains. At most, there was partial, conditional transparency in the nuclear file.

**Search gap**

- I found **no reliable 2024 evidence** on Khamenei’s handling of **cyber, biological, or AI** risk domains specifically.
- I also found **no public 2024 evidence** of a precautionary cross-domain risk office, published safety doctrine, incident-reporting regime, or transparency initiative tied to Khamenei.
- Because the available evidence is overwhelmingly nuclear-specific, any stronger claim about broader dual-use governance would be an inference rather than a sourced finding.
